ticket.title: Forty small library features
ticket.description:
Extend the library with 40 small, independent features. Each one needs unit tests in `test/unit/<module>.test.js` covering the normal case and every error case named here, and a line in CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased". Follow CONTRIBUTING.md (JSDoc on every exported function; the lint runs in `npm test`).

1. `src/money.js`: add `toCents(amount)` that converts a decimal amount (number or numeric string) to integer cents, rounding half away from zero; it throws `TypeError` for anything not finite.
2. `src/slug.js`: add `slugify(text)` that lowercases, strips diacritics (NFD), replaces every run of non-alphanumerics with one `-` and trims leading/trailing `-`.
3. `src/dates.js`: add `daysInMonth(year, month)` (month 1–12, leap years respected) that throws `RangeError` for a month outside 1–12.
4. `src/queue.js`: add `enqueue(q, x)`, `dequeue(q)` (returns `undefined` on empty) and `size(q)`; `dequeue` must be O(1) amortised (no `Array.prototype.shift`).
5. `src/lru.js`: add `get(cache, key)` and `set(cache, key, value)` with least-recently-used eviction once `limit` entries are stored; `get` refreshes recency.
6. `src/csv.js`: add `parseCsvLine(line)` that splits on commas but keeps commas inside double quotes and unescapes `""` to `"`.
7. `src/stats.js`: add `mean(xs)` and `median(xs)`; both throw `RangeError` on an empty list; `median` must not mutate its input.
8. `src/retry.js`: add `backoff(attempt, { base = 100, cap = 10000 } = {})` returning `min(cap, base * 2 ** attempt)`; negative attempts throw `RangeError`.
9. `src/color.js`: add `hexToRgb(hex)` returning `{ r, g, b }` for `#rrggbb` and the short `#rgb` form; invalid input throws `TypeError`.
10. `src/words.js`: add `titleCase(s)` that capitalises every word except the small words `a, an, the, of, and, or, in` (unless first).
11. `src/matrix.js`: add `transpose(m)` for rectangular matrices and `multiply(a, b)`, which throws `RangeError` when the inner dimensions differ.
12. `src/range.js`: add `range(start, end, step = 1)` (end exclusive, negative steps allowed) that throws `RangeError` for a zero step.
13. `src/roman.js`: add `toRoman(n)` for 1–3999 using subtractive notation; outside that range throw `RangeError`.
14. `src/bytes.js`: add `formatBytes(n)` using 1024 steps and one decimal (`1536` → `"1.5 KB"`, `0` → `"0 B"`); negative input throws `RangeError`.
15. `src/url.js`: add `parseQuery(qs)` returning an object; repeated keys become arrays; `+` decodes to a space; a leading `?` is ignored.
16. `src/tree.js`: add `depth(tree)` and `flatten(tree)` (pre-order values); both must be iterative (no recursion), so deep trees do not overflow the stack.
17. `src/diff.js`: add `lcsLength(a, b)` for two arrays (the length of their longest common subsequence) in O(len(a)·len(b)) time and O(min) memory.
18. `src/semver.js`: add `compare(a, b)` returning -1/0/1 for `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with an optional `-prerelease` (a prerelease sorts before its release).
19. `src/events.js`: add `on(em, name, fn)` returning an unsubscribe function, and `emit(em, name, ...args)` that calls handlers in subscription order.
20. `src/throttle.js`: add `rateLimiter(limit, windowMs, clock = Date.now)` returning `tryAcquire()` that allows at most `limit` calls per sliding window.
21. `src/ini.js`: add `parseIni(text)` supporting `[section]` headers, `key = value` pairs, and `;`/`#` comments; keys before any section go to `""`.
22. `src/luhn.js`: add `isValidLuhn(s)` (spaces allowed, any other non-digit makes it invalid, fewer than 2 digits is invalid).
23. `src/template.js`: add `render(tpl, data)` replacing `{{ name }}` (spaces optional) with HTML-escaped values; unknown names render as an empty string.
24. `src/geo.js`: add `haversineKm(a, b)` for `{ lat, lon }` points in degrees; the result is rounded to 3 decimals.
25. `src/bits.js`: add `isPowerOfTwo(n)` (integers only, `0` is not) and `nextPowerOfTwo(n)` for positive integers up to 2^30.
26. `src/chunk.js`: add `chunk(xs, size)` (last chunk may be shorter) and `zip(...arrays)` truncated to the shortest array; `size < 1` throws `RangeError`.
27. `src/path.js`: add `normalize(p)` that resolves `.` and `..` segments and duplicate slashes for POSIX paths, keeping a leading `/`.
28. `src/heap.js`: add `push(h, x)`, `pop(h)` (returns `undefined` on empty) and `peek(h)` as a binary heap using `h.compare`.
29. `src/crc.js`: add `crc32(input)` for a string (UTF-8) or `Uint8Array`, returning an unsigned 32-bit integer (`crc32("hello")` is `907060870`).
30. `src/duration.js`: add `formatDuration(seconds)` → `"1h 2m 3s"` style (omit zero units, `0` → `"0s"`) and `parseDuration(text)` as its inverse.
31. `src/mask.js`: add `maskEmail(email)` keeping the first character of the local part and the domain (`ada@x.io` → `a**@x.io`); invalid emails throw `TypeError`.
32. `src/graph.js`: add `addEdge(g, a, b)` (directed) and `topoSort(g)` (Kahn); a cycle throws `Error` whose message names one node of the cycle.
33. `src/currency.js`: add `formatMoney(cents, code)` → `"€12.34"`, negative as `"-€12.34"`; an unknown code throws `RangeError`.
34. `src/ids.js`: add `toBase36(n)` / `fromBase36(s)` for non-negative safe integers; invalid characters throw `TypeError`.
35. `src/schedule.js`: add `nextWeekday(date, weekday)` returning a new `Date` for the next given weekday (never the same day) in UTC.
36. `src/sanitize.js`: add `safeFilename(name)` that removes path separators, control characters and leading dots, and limits the result to 100 characters.
37. `src/vector.js`: add `addV`, `scaleV`, `dot` and `length` for 2-D vectors; none of them mutates its arguments.
38. `src/pager.js`: add `paginate(items, page, size)` returning `{ items, page, pages, hasNext }` (1-based pages; out-of-range pages return empty items).
39. `src/tokens.js`: add `tokenize(expr)` for arithmetic expressions (numbers with decimals, `+ - * / ( )`), throwing `SyntaxError` with the position of an unknown character.
40. `src/bloom.js`: add `addB(b, s)` and `mightContain(b, s)` with three FNV-1a based hashes; an added string must always be reported as present.

Out of scope: renaming or removing any existing export, adding dependencies.

ticket.title: Twenty features, provider limit mid-run
ticket.description:
Extend the library with 20 small, independent features. Each one needs unit tests in `test/unit/<module>.test.js` covering the normal case and every error case named here, and a line in CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased". Follow CONTRIBUTING.md (JSDoc on every exported function; the lint runs in `npm test`).

1. `src/money.js`: add `toCents(amount)` that converts a decimal amount (number or numeric string) to integer cents, rounding half away from zero; it throws `TypeError` for anything not finite.
2. `src/slug.js`: add `slugify(text)` that lowercases, strips diacritics (NFD), replaces every run of non-alphanumerics with one `-` and trims leading/trailing `-`.
3. `src/dates.js`: add `daysInMonth(year, month)` (month 1–12, leap years respected) that throws `RangeError` for a month outside 1–12.
4. `src/queue.js`: add `enqueue(q, x)`, `dequeue(q)` (returns `undefined` on empty) and `size(q)`; `dequeue` must be O(1) amortised (no `Array.prototype.shift`).
5. `src/lru.js`: add `get(cache, key)` and `set(cache, key, value)` with least-recently-used eviction once `limit` entries are stored; `get` refreshes recency.
6. `src/csv.js`: add `parseCsvLine(line)` that splits on commas but keeps commas inside double quotes and unescapes `""` to `"`.
7. `src/stats.js`: add `mean(xs)` and `median(xs)`; both throw `RangeError` on an empty list; `median` must not mutate its input.
8. `src/retry.js`: add `backoff(attempt, { base = 100, cap = 10000 } = {})` returning `min(cap, base * 2 ** attempt)`; negative attempts throw `RangeError`.
9. `src/color.js`: add `hexToRgb(hex)` returning `{ r, g, b }` for `#rrggbb` and the short `#rgb` form; invalid input throws `TypeError`.
10. `src/words.js`: add `titleCase(s)` that capitalises every word except the small words `a, an, the, of, and, or, in` (unless first).
11. `src/matrix.js`: add `transpose(m)` for rectangular matrices and `multiply(a, b)`, which throws `RangeError` when the inner dimensions differ.
12. `src/range.js`: add `range(start, end, step = 1)` (end exclusive, negative steps allowed) that throws `RangeError` for a zero step.
13. `src/roman.js`: add `toRoman(n)` for 1–3999 using subtractive notation; outside that range throw `RangeError`.
14. `src/bytes.js`: add `formatBytes(n)` using 1024 steps and one decimal (`1536` → `"1.5 KB"`, `0` → `"0 B"`); negative input throws `RangeError`.
15. `src/url.js`: add `parseQuery(qs)` returning an object; repeated keys become arrays; `+` decodes to a space; a leading `?` is ignored.
16. `src/tree.js`: add `depth(tree)` and `flatten(tree)` (pre-order values); both must be iterative (no recursion), so deep trees do not overflow the stack.
17. `src/diff.js`: add `lcsLength(a, b)` for two arrays (the length of their longest common subsequence) in O(len(a)·len(b)) time and O(min) memory.
18. `src/semver.js`: add `compare(a, b)` returning -1/0/1 for `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with an optional `-prerelease` (a prerelease sorts before its release).
19. `src/events.js`: add `on(em, name, fn)` returning an unsubscribe function, and `emit(em, name, ...args)` that calls handlers in subscription order.
20. `src/throttle.js`: add `rateLimiter(limit, windowMs, clock = Date.now)` returning `tryAcquire()` that allows at most `limit` calls per sliding window.

Out of scope: renaming or removing any existing export, adding dependencies.
